title: Only 52% of Americans Are Middle Class. Are You? #shorts
description:
Are you middle class? Only about half of US adults are: 52%, according to Pew Research Center. 28% are lower income and 19% upper income.

Pew's definition: household income between two-thirds and double the national median, adjusted for household size. For a household of three, that was about $56,600 to $169,800 (2022 dollars, 2022 American Community Survey data). The typical US household earned $87,460 in 2025 (US Census Bureau).

Your own range depends on household size and local cost of living. Pew has a calculator for that.

Sources: Pew Research Center, "Are you in the American middle class?" (Sept 16, 2024); US Census Bureau median household income 2025 via FRED (MEHOINUSA646N).

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
